title: Monotonicity in the acceptance probability
statement: Let $\rho',\rho\in\mathbb{Q}$ satisfy $\rho'\le\rho$, and let $T:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$. Every language decidable by a randomized machine in time bounded by a constant multiple of $T$ with acceptance probability at least $\rho$ on every input is also decidable under the same time bound with acceptance probability at least $\rho'$.
